summary.text: Ryan Fazio is a Republican state senator from Greenwich and the Republican and Independent Party nominee for governor, with running mate Matt Corey. First elected in a 2021 special election, he is the ranking senator on the Energy and Technology Committee. His platform centers on cutting income taxes and electricity bills, capping property taxes and a 'Grand Bargain' on housing that protects local zoning control.

paragraphs.text: Grew up in Greenwich; B.A. in economics from Northwestern University (2012); worked mostly in the commodities industry and is now a financial advisor.
Won a 2021 special election for the 36th Senate district, ending the Democratic supermajority, and was re-elected in 2022 and 2024.
